image_description: A close-up view of a grey whale's head and upper back emerging from blue ocean water. The skin is dark grey with distinctive white mottling (barnacles/lice). The arched rostrum is visible, but blowholes are obscured by the angle and water. No dorsal fin is present, consistent with the species, though dorsal knuckles are not clearly distinct in this specific crop. Pectoral fins and tail flukes are completely submerged/out of frame.
